name: Hakodate (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with a five-pointed star outline enclosing a pentagonal knot.
history: The flag of Hakodate bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Hakodate municipal emblem — a five-pointed star outline enclosing a pentagonal knot
features.symbolism: the star-shaped Goryōkaku fortress, Hakodate's landmark
